backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a cloud storage backend that composes access control and blob storage mixins, and defines types/state for files, folders, trash, sharing, notifications, activity logs, and user profiles with quota management.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a single feature fix for the grid/list view toggle in the FileList component, linking it to relevant files, components, and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference document for the project's frontend architecture.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point that defines CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, radius, sidebar, and chart variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React app that mounts the root div and loads the main TypeScript entry point as an ES module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that sets up TanStack Router with all page routes, wraps the app in QueryClient/ThemeProvider/Toaster providers, and handles authentication flow including identity initialization, actor setup, and first-time profile creation.
frontend/src/components/ActivityFeed.tsx: Displays a scrollable list of recent file activities (upload, download, delete) with icons and relative timestamps, showing loading and empty states as needed.
frontend/src/components/CreateFolderDial: Modal dialog component for creating a new folder or subfolder, with a name input, validation, and toast notifications for success or failure.
frontend/src/components/DeleteConfirmati: An alert dialog for permanently deleting selected trash items, showing file count, total size, and an optional secure wipe checkbox before confirming deletion.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFileDialog: A dialog for moving a single file to trash, allowing the user to select a retention period (30, 60, or 90 days) before confirming.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderConf: An alert dialog for permanently deleting one or more trashed folders, warning that all contained files and subfolders will also be irreversibly deleted.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderToTr: A dialog for moving a folder to trash with a selectable retention period (30, 60, or 90 days), calling an async onConfirm handler and showing toast notifications on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: A React class-based error boundary that catches rendering errors and displays a fallback UI with options to retry or reload the page.
frontend/src/components/FileFilterDropdo: A dropdown UI component providing filter controls for files by name, type, date range, and size range, with an active filter count badge and a clear-all option.
frontend/src/components/FileList.tsx: A file and folder listing component that supports search, filtering, sorting, and pagination, with per-item actions including preview, favorite, move, and delete-to-trash.
frontend/src/components/FilePreview.tsx: A full-screen modal component that previews files (images, videos, PDFs, text) by generating blob URLs or decoding text content, with a download button and close control.
A debounced search input component with a clear button for filtering files by name or type.
frontend/src/components/FileSortDropdown: A dropdown menu component for sorting files by name, date, size, or type, displaying the current sort field and direction with icons.
frontend/src/components/FileToolbar.tsx: A composite toolbar component combining search, filter, sort, and grid/list view-mode toggle controls for the file browser.
frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx: A drag-and-drop file upload component that queues multiple files, uploads them to an optional folder, and tracks recent uploads via context.
frontend/src/components/FolderBreadcrumb: Renders a breadcrumb navigation bar showing the root and current folder name, with click handlers to navigate between folders.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: The sticky top navigation header with app branding, theme toggle, notification bell with unread badge, and a user avatar dropdown for logout.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The root layout component that composes the Header, Sidebar, and an ErrorBoundary-wrapped Outlet for page content.
frontend/src/components/LoadingTimeout.t: A wrapper component that shows a timeout error UI with a refresh button if the loading state exceeds a configurable duration (default 45 seconds).
frontend/src/components/MoveFolderDialog: A dialog component for moving a folder to a new parent destination, filtering out the folder's own descendants as invalid targets and showing a confirmation step before executing the move via the `useMoveFolder` mutation.
frontend/src/components/MoveToFolderDial: A dialog component that lets users move one or more files to a selected folder, displaying available folders in a radio group and calling the `useMoveFilesToFolder` mutation on confirmation.
frontend/src/components/Notifications.ts: Renders a list of user notifications (storage warnings, share alerts, activity alerts, system announcements) fetched via `useGetNotifications`, with loading skeletons, error state, and click-to-mark-as-read functionality.
frontend/src/components/PaginationContro: A reusable pagination UI component that displays item range info, an items-per-page selector, and page navigation buttons with ellipsis logic for large page counts.
frontend/src/components/PinnedFiles.tsx: Displays a horizontally scrollable list of the user's favorited/pinned files fetched via `useGetFavorites`, showing file name and size with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: A first-time profile setup form that collects a display name and optional email, then saves them via the `useSaveCallerUserProfile` mutation before invoking an `onProfileSaved` callback.
frontend/src/components/QuickActions.tsx: Renders three quick-action buttons (Upload Files, New Folder, Create Text Document) that trigger file uploads, folder creation dialog, or blank text file creation, using identity checks and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/RecentActivityCa: Displays a list of recent file activities (upload, delete, restore, share) fetched via useGetRecentActivities, with loading skeletons, error state, and empty state handling.
frontend/src/components/RenameFolderDial: A modal dialog that allows users to rename an existing folder, validating the new name and calling the useRenameFolder mutation with success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/RestoreDialog.ts: A modal dialog for restoring trashed files or folders, letting users choose between restoring to the original location or a custom path.
frontend/src/components/SharedByMe.tsx: Lists files the current user has shared with others, supporting search and pagination, and allows revoking individual shares via the useRevokeShare mutation.
frontend/src/components/SharedWithMe.tsx: Displays files shared with the current user with search and pagination, and provides preview and download actions while recording file access events.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Renders a collapsible sidebar with navigation links (Home, My Files, Shared, Recent, Trash, Settings, and conditionally Admin) and a storage quota indicator at the bottom.
frontend/src/components/SmartSuggestions: Displays a list of AI-driven file suggestions based on access history, with loading skeletons, error, and empty states.
Shows a storage usage card with a color-coded progress bar and used/total byte labels, fetched via the storage quota query.
frontend/src/components/StorageQuotaIndi: Compact sidebar storage indicator showing a small progress bar and used/total storage text, using the same quota query as StorageOverview.
frontend/src/components/TrashFilters.tsx: Provides filter controls (search, file type, owner, date range, original path) for the trash view, applying filters reactively and notifying the parent via callbacks.
frontend/src/components/TrashStorageIndi: Displays a card showing how much storage the trash is consuming and its percentage of the user's total quota.
frontend/src/components/UserStorageManag: Admin component that lists all users' storage usage in a table and allows editing individual user quotas via a dialog.
frontend/src/contexts/RecentUploadsConte: React context that tracks recently uploaded files in local state, exposing add and clear helpers to consumers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated (or anonymous) backend actor using TanStack Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileFilters.ts: Custom React hook that manages file filter state (name, type, date range, size range) and exposes a memoized `filterFiles` function to apply those filters to a `FileMetadata` array.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSearch.ts: Custom React hook that maintains a search query string and provides a memoized `searchFiles` function that filters `FileMetadata` by file name or extension.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSorting.ts: Custom React hook that manages sort field and order state, exposing a memoized `sortFiles` function to sort `FileMetadata` arrays by name, date, size, or type.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` context and `useInternetIdentity` hook that wrap DFINITY's `AuthClient` to handle ICP Internet Identity login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/usePagination.ts: Generic React hook that manages pagination state (current page, items per page) and provides a `paginatedData` function to slice any array to the current page.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for backend interactions, including queries and mutations for user profiles, roles, files, folders, trash, favorites, notifications, sharing, and activity logs via the canister actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Tailwind CSS directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a `cn` utility function that merges Tailwind CSS class names using `clsx` and `tailwind-merge`.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider` wrappers around the root `App` component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin-only page that checks caller admin status and renders summary stat cards alongside `UserStorageManager` and `ActivityFeed` components; shows an access-denied card for non-admins.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main file management page that renders a folder breadcrumb navigation, collapsible file upload area, file/folder list, and a create-folder dialog with folder navigation state.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Dashboard home page that displays storage overview, quick actions, pinned files, recent activity, notifications, and smart suggestions in a grid layout. Wraps content in RecentUploadsProvider context.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page that presents Internet Identity authentication with a feature highlights panel (encryption, access, privacy, speed) and a sign-in button using the useInternetIdentity hook.
frontend/src/pages/Recent.tsx: Page showing recently uploaded files in the current session, with search, filter, sort, pagination, preview, download, and favorite toggle functionality built on top of RecentUploadsContext.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page allowing users to view account info, configure trash retention period (30/60/90 days), and manage theme preferences using next-themes and backend query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/Shared.tsx: Shared files page with two tabs — 'Shared With Me' and 'Shared By Me' — rendering the SharedWithMe and SharedByMe components respectively.
frontend/src/pages/Trash.tsx: Trash management page that lists deleted files and folders with sorting, filtering, bulk selection, restore, and permanent delete actions, supporting admin owner filtering and separate pagination per tab.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius variables, accordion keyframe animations, and typography/container-queries/animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking a fix request to correct the Grid & List view toggle in the 'My Files' dashboard section so that viewMode state is properly initialized and passed to the file rendering logic.
